en: Dependent on a state that is neither a canker (*āsava*) nor a fetter (*saññojana*) ... (Abbreviated.
Five in the case of root-cause (*hetu*), two in the case of object-condition (*ārammaṇa*) ... pe ... one in the case of result (*vipāka*) ... pe ... five in the case of non-disappearance (*avigata*).
Dependent on a state that is neither a canker nor a bond (*gantha*) ... pe ... dependent on a state that is neither a canker nor a flood (*ogha*) ... pe ... neither a canker ...
Dependent on a state that is neither yoga, neither refuge, nor hindrance … dependent on a state that is neither refuge nor attachment … (Abbreviated.
Under root-condition there are five; under object-condition two … under resultant-condition one … under non-disappearance-condition five.
